verdict.rationale: Lium documents fully browser-free operation: an agent can sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods without a browser. Automation is supported by an official CLI with TTL auto-removal and `lium exec`, which returns the remote command's exit code, plus an SDK, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, scoped API keys with server-enforced budgets, and stable `error.code` values to branch on. The OpenAPI probe 404s only at docs.lium.io paths, while the docs point to lium.io/api/openapi.json, so it does not contradict the API claim. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions or env-var auth recipes) and independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.
